doc_numbering.py PUT does upsert with $setOnInsert on id — correct idempotent behaviour.

ProductionDashboardOverview.jsx line 117 gates stage buttons behind 'pipeline has data' — empty state shows data-testid='prod-pipeline-empty'. Test expectations should acknowledge stage buttons only render when data exists. Not a bug, just a UX detail.

Backup Koleksi Database tab: client-side checkboxes for protected collections are NOT disabled (all 187 enabled). Protection is enforced server-side only (returns 400). Consider disabling checkbox client-side for protected items OR at least visually locking them. Currently lock icon is shown; that's acceptable.

gen_prefixed_number counter mutation via API accepts start_from=9000 without any warning about the impact on production doc numbering. Should perhaps warn when start_from is much larger than current or require additional confirmation. LOW priority.
